key.name: duration
key.description: Duration of the minimize/unminimize animation in milliseconds.

key.name: final-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the window at the end of minimize (0-255).

key.name: bounce-scale
key.description: How much the window grows before shrinking (e.g. 1.1 = 10% growth). Set to 1.0 to disable bounce.

key.name: bounce-ratio
key.description: Percentage of time spent on the bounce phase (0.0 - 1.0).

key.name: animation-curve
key.description: 0: Ease In Expo (Suction), 1: Ease Out Expo (Glide), 2: Linear
